items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: No, I never played with him.

ctx.x: Well, uh, I can't recall all the fellas' names now because it's been quite a while, but they used to have a fella who played tramwain with us by the name of, um, it's in on Ramport Street, man. The old man used to play tramwain. He played brass band music too, he was well known. Carnish. Oh, yeah. Carnish. Oh, yeah. He used to play with us. And he's an old-time trombone player. He died, but he was good. He used to play in brass band music.
Now, uh, did you ever play with Frankie Dooson at any time? Do you remember Frankie Dooson on trombone?
No, I never played with him. I, uh, uh, Who'd he have on clarinet with him then at that time, uh, Sammy? Can you remember?
